remarks: Sophisticated, detached single family residence in Stamford's exclusive Stonebrook enclave within the desirable Turn of the River - Newfield neighborhood surrounded by neighboring $2M homes yet privately set on a quiet cul de sac with wooded backdrop. Positioned on a desirable corner lot offering additional privacy and presence. A rare offering that blends luxury, privacy and low maintenance living in one of Stamford's most convenient locations. Thoughtfully designed open floor plan with soaring ceilings, loft overlooking the main living space, fireplace, sun filled interiors and seamless flow ideal for entertaining. 3 BR, 2.5 BA including a spacious primary suite with ensuite bath and walk in closet. Charming porch and exceptional natural light throughout. Experience single family comfort paired with condo association benefits and beautifully maintained grounds. Set on approximately 30 acres with 20 acres of protected conservation land creating a peaceful park like setting just 3 min to Merritt Pkwy and 4 min to High Ridge shopping and Trader Joe's. Approx. 400 sqft 2 car garage plus guest parking. On demand hot water, newer windows, updated appliances and W D. An exceptional blend of elegance, convenience and community in desirable Turn of the River Newfield.
